Usage: input send-mouse [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Send a mouse event via Input System in Play Mode. Requires com.unity.inputsystem.

Arguments:
  [0] <float>    X coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.width space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases to the right. Note: capture_screenshot screenshots use top-left origin and may include editor chrome, so coordinates from screenshots must be converted.
  [1] <float>    Y coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.height space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases upward. This is the inverse of typical image coordinates where Y increases downward.

Options:
  --button <string>        Mouse button: "left" (default), "right", or "middle". (Default: @"left")
  --event-type <string>    Event type: "click" (default, press then release after one frame), "press", "release", or "move" (position only, no button). (Default: @"click")
